tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha zhon pa rnams bstan pa bzhugs// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha zhon pa bstan pa ni/ bdag nyid chen mo ni/ sku mdog mthing nag nam za nang ma dmar mo/ phyi ber ljang ser/ dbu la prog zhu/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon khram shing 'dzin pa/ zhon pa shwa mo yu mo la zhon pa/ dpal ldan ha ri ni/ sku mdog ser mo/ nam za nang gong dang 'dra ba/ phyi ber ljang nag dbu la prog zhu/ phyag g.yas rdo rje kun 'dra ba la/ g.yon rdo rje'i zhags pa/ zhon pa rta dmar po/ gsang ba'i yum chen ni/ sku mdog dmar mo/ nang gos ljang nag phye ber dmar po/ phyag g.yon thod khrag zhon pa bong bu/ 'brog chen 'khor 'dus/ sku mdog ljang khu/ nang gos dmar/ phyi ber ljang ser/ phyag g.yon be con/ rnga mo gwa pa la zhon pa/ gangs dkar sha med ni/ sku mdog ser mo/ nang gos 'dra/ phyi ber ljang ser/ phyag g.yon ral gri/ stag la zhon pa/ gser chen mkha' lding ni/ sku mdog ser mo/ nang gos 'dra/ phye ber ljang nag phyag g.yon dgra satwa 'dzin pa/ glang dmar po la zhon pa/ kha rag khyung btsun ni/ sku mdog dmar mo/ nang gos ljang ser/ phyi ber dmar po/ g.yon dbyug pas mtshan pa'i lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ dom nag la zhon pa/ sman ri rab 'byams ni/ sku mdog ljang khu/ nang gos dmar/ phyi ber ljang ser/ phyag g.yon tsitta 'dzin pa/ mi dred la zhon pa/ kong btsun de mo ni/ sku mdog dkar mo/ nang gos dmar/ phyi ber ljang khu/ phyag g.yon rdo rje'i zhags pa/ rwa bcu shwa ba la zhon pa/ btsan la la rog ni/ sku mdog ser mo/ nang gos dmar/ phyi ber ljang nag phyag g.yon dril bu/ rtsos la zhon pa/ sman btsun ug chos ni/ sku mdog dmar mo/ nang gos dmar/ phyi ber ljang khu/ phyag g.yon mtshon sna lnga'i gru lu 'dzin pa/ 'bri mo la zhon pa/ g.yu'i dril bu ni/ sku mdog ljang nag

nang gos dmar po/ phyi ber ljang nag phyag g.yon dbyug pa'i mtshan pa'i lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ rkyang la zhon pa/ 'di thams cad kyi spyi bor u rgyan chen pos rgyan pa// ༈ /bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi bsgom tshul ni/ rdo rje kun grags ma mthing kha/ khram 'phang 'dzin pa shwa ba la zhon pa/ ha ri ni mdog ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa rta la zhon pa/ gangs kyi yum chen ni mthing kha ral gri 'dzin pa stag la zhon pa/ 'brog chen ljang khu be con 'dzin pa rnga mo la zhon pa/ gangs dkar sha med dmar mo thod khrag 'dzin pa bong bu la zhon pa/ mkha' lding dmar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa dom la zhon pa/ kha rag khyung btsun ser mo dgra satwa 'dzin pa rta la zhon pa/ sman ri ljang khu snying 'dzin pa dred la zhon pa/ kong btsun dkar mo zhags pa 'dzin pa shwa ba la zhon pa/ btsan la la rog ser mo dril bu 'dzin pa rtsos la zhon pa/ sman btsun ma dmar mo mtshon gru 'dzin pa 'bri la zhon pa/ g.yu'i dril bu nag mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa rkyang la zhon pa'o/ /bstan ma'i bsgom tshul 'di sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha bzhon pa rnams bstan pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
